improvedVsOld: The new text is clearly better than the old in most units. The broken slogans are fixed ('Verificar o atual conta' becomes 'Confirma sempre o mais recente'; 'Cada local abre com o detalhe que decide' becomes 'Cada ficha mostra logo o que te faz decidir'; 'Há duas espécies' becomes 'Há dois tipos'). The app labels now match the glossary (Gosto, Com estrela, Quero visitar, Pins, Todos os guardados), 'autossuficiente' becomes 'autónomo', and every 'offline' claim in the changed units is rewritten as 'abre sem rede' or 'incluídos na app'. Prices change from $ to 'NZD' after the amount, and times use 22h/7h/16h/21h. Local terms get a gloss on first use (DOC, MBIE, Stats NZ, RUC, honesty box, rāhui, whitebait, Class 1, LSZ, pounamu, TVDE). Meta descriptions now include the target keywords, and the body prose reads like a native travel writer with natural tu voice and rhythm. There are no em dashes, no 'você', no Brazilianisms and no 'mapa offline' in the changed units. Markup and numbers are intact. A few things are worse: the generic 'parques de campismo' became 'áreas de campismo' in UI and meta text, against the glossary; ui.metaDescription grew to 209 characters; and a handful of eyebrows and labels are weaker idioms ('O prato principal', 'casa que levas às costas', 'Refúgios Basic').
criticalIssues: The Portuguese privacy page is one section short and its sections are out of order. The English page (at origin/main and at the merge base) has 7 sections, including 'Website analytics' (GA4, 4 paragraphs). pt.json has 6, and its effective date is still 12 de agosto de 2026, where EN says 19 October 2026. isPageComplete() in /Users/cristian/Developer/Webs/kiwicamping-web/lib/localized.ts rejects the page, so /pt/privacy is served in English and every rewritten privacy unit on this branch is dead text. This gap existed before the branch, and all other locales on main share it, but this branch claims to rewrite privacy and does not fix it.
pt.json has no consent.* block (label, text, accept, decline, policy, choices), so the GA4 consent bar on /pt/ falls back to English.

failingUnits.problem: The English privacy page has 7 sections. The 'Website analytics' section (GA4, 4 paragraphs) is missing, so every later section is shifted by one: pt sections[4] sits where EN 'Website analytics' is, and pt sections[5] has 2 paragraphs where EN has 1. The effective date is still 12 Aug, but EN says 19 Oct 2026. lib/localized.ts isPageComplete() therefore rejects the pt privacy page and /pt/privacy renders in English, so none of the rewritten privacy units ever show. This gap existed before the branch (old pt also had 6 sections) and was not fixed by the 'rewrite the support, privacy and terms pages' commit.

Shift 'Conservação e controlo dos dados' to [5] and 'Crianças e contacto' to [6]. Set effective to 'Em vigor a partir de 19 de outubro de 2026'.
